newsitem.title: USA: Starbucks sees EPS $0.70 in FY97.
newsitem.headline: Starbucks sees EPS $0.70 in FY97.

text.p: Starbucks Corp will meet its earnings target of $0.70 a share for the year ending September 30, the retail coffee chain's chief financial officer said Wednesday.
"We will be able to meet our target earnings per share of $0.70 in (fiscal) 1997," CFO Michael Casey said during a presentation to analysts at the Robsinson-Humphrey annual institutional conference.
Casey acknowledged that raw coffee prices have been rising for several weeks but said the company did not believe the increases will stick, based on the fundamental supply and demand situation.
In fiscal 1996 the Seattle-based company earned $0.47 per share before a one-time gain.
